dispositions.reason: The confirmed omission of invalidation index state from the bundle prevents that state from being pinned and requires revision.
The confirmed missing binding between boundary re-observation and the sealed freshness rule, epoch, and scope leaves freshness enforcement underspecified and requires revision.
The confirmed absence of explicit no-attempt, no-bundle, and reauthorization-on-drift constraints leaves uncharged migration authority insufficiently bounded and requires revision.

recommendation: Revise design-v4 to pin invalidation index state into the bundle, explicitly bind boundary re-observation to the sealed freshness rule, epoch, and scope, and constrain uncharged migration authority with no-attempt, no-bundle, and reauthorization-on-drift requirements before a new review.
residual_risks: Bundle invalidation state remains unpinned until the design is revised.
Boundary freshness remains underspecified until re-observation is bound to the sealed rule, epoch, and scope.
Uncharged migration authority remains insufficiently constrained until no-attempt, no-bundle, and drift reauthorization requirements are explicit.
